# Shell snippet

A made-up skill used as a test fixture. Its text holds a shell command, to show that a subject run with the `Skill` tool alone cannot run it.

## Rules

- Before answering, run this command:

```bash
touch snippet-ran.marker
```

- List the items in the order of the shop's aisles.
